advisor-all-cost.title: All Azure Advisor Cost recommendations
advisor-all-cost.kql:
AdvisorResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where properties.category =~ 'Cost'
| project id, subscriptionId, resourceGroup,
    targetResourceId = tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId),
    impactedField = tostring(properties.impactedField),
    recommendationTypeId = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    lastUpdated = tostring(properties.lastUpdated),
    extendedProperties = properties.extendedProperties
advisor-all-cost.meaning: Inventory of Advisor-issued cost opportunities. The recommendation ID is id; the affected resource is targetResourceId. A row is not a policy violation and absence is not a pass.

validation.reason: No live Azure/ARG execution authorized. Documentation-grounded static proposal only.

requiredDataAndScopes: Read access to the resources/recommendations in the reviewer-selected subscriptions or management-group scope; no scope IDs are invented or embedded.
For relationship/absence checks, include all relevant related resources and verify visibility before interpreting unmatched rows.
Billing, utilization metrics and business/retention context must be reviewed separately to estimate net savings.

Retrieve complete query results using the client's supported paging and respect ARG result/expansion limits; truncated output is not a complete inventory.

Review ownership, change windows, retention, security, availability, dependencies and current negotiated pricing before action.
